devicePoweredOff: The device is turned off. Turn it on before running commands.
noTerminal: This device has no command line. The terminal is only available on computers, POS terminals and video recorders (NVR).
unknownCommand: '{{command}}' is not a recognized command in this lab. Type 'help' to see the available commands.
pingContinuousNotSupported: Continuous ping (-t) is not supported in this lab; 4 echo requests are sent instead.

usage.ping: Usage: ping [-n count] [-l size] [-t] [-4] <IP address or name>  (example: ping -n 2 8.8.8.8)
usage.tracert: Usage: tracert [-d] [-4] <IP address or name>  (example: tracert 8.8.8.8)

help.title: Available commands:
help.ipconfig: ipconfig               Shows the IP address, subnet mask and default gateway
help.ipconfigAll: ipconfig /all          All details, including MAC address, DHCP status and DNS servers
help.ipconfigRenew: ipconfig /renew        Asks the DHCP server for an IP address again
help.ipconfigRelease: ipconfig /release      Gives the DHCP address back; the adapter is left without an address
help.ping: ping <ip or name>      Tests whether an address can be reached
help.pingCount: -n <count>           Number of echo requests (at most 20 are shown)
help.pingSize: -l <size>            Bytes of data per request (0 to 65500)
help.pingContinuous: -t                   Continuous ping; in this lab 4 requests are sent
help.tracert: tracert <ip or name>   Lists the routers (hops) on the way to an address
help.nslookup: nslookup <name>        Asks the DNS server which IP address a name belongs to
